county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The nap mats were not labeled with the children names.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §746.3421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The sink in the infant room was not operational. The infants were not having their hands washed with soap and water.  This was corrected at the inspection when the infants were moved to a classroom with a proper working sink.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The use zone for the slides lacked the required perimeter.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
